body.id: Dahulu cengkih dan pala hanya tumbuh di Kepulauan Maluku. Pedagang dari negeri jauh datang mencarinya.
body.en: Long ago, cloves and nutmeg grew only in the Maluku Islands. Traders came from faraway lands to find them.

body.id: Kapal layar berlayar mengikuti angin musim. Pelabuhan dan kerajaan pesisir, seperti Sriwijaya di Sumatra dan Majapahit di Jawa, menjadi ramai.
body.en: Sailing ships followed the seasonal winds. Ports and coastal kingdoms, such as Srivijaya in Sumatra and Majapahit in Java, grew busy.

body.id: Lewat jalur rempah, barang, bahasa, dan cerita ikut berpindah antarbangsa.
body.en: Along the spice routes, goods, languages and stories travelled between peoples too.

body.id: Produsen membuat barang atau memberi jasa; konsumen memakainya. Petani produsen padi, dan kita konsumen saat makan nasi.
body.en: Producers make goods or provide services; consumers use them. A farmer produces rice, and we are consumers when we eat it.

body.id: Barang bisa dipegang, seperti roti dan sepatu. Jasa adalah pekerjaan untuk orang lain, seperti mengajar dan memperbaiki motor.
body.en: Goods are things you can hold, like bread and shoes. Services are work done for others, like teaching or fixing a motorbike.

body.id: Harga cenderung naik jika barangnya sedikit tetapi banyak yang mau membeli, dan turun jika barangnya melimpah.
body.en: Prices tend to rise when there is little of something but many people want it, and fall when there is plenty.

meaning.id: Cengkih dan pala berasal dari sini.
meaning.en: Cloves and nutmeg come from here.

model_answer.id: Cengkih dan pala tanaman asli Kepulauan Maluku.
model_answer.en: Cloves and nutmeg are native to the Maluku Islands.

meaning.id: Rempah dibawa ke negeri jauh dengan…
meaning.en: Spices travelled to faraway lands by…

model_answer.id: Kapal layar membawa rempah menyeberangi samudra.
model_answer.en: Sailing ships carried spices across the oceans.

meaning.en: Spice → where it was grown.

model_answer.id: Cengkih dari Ternate dan Tidore, pala dari Banda, lada banyak ditanam di Lampung.
model_answer.en: Cloves from Ternate and Tidore, nutmeg from Banda, and pepper grown widely in Lampung.

meaning.en: Srivijaya was centred on this island.

model_answer.id: Sriwijaya berpusat di sekitar Palembang, Sumatra.
model_answer.en: Srivijaya was centred around Palembang, Sumatra.

meaning.id: Dahulu pala hanya tumbuh di Kepulauan Banda.
meaning.en: Long ago, nutmeg grew only in the Banda Islands.

model_answer.id: Pohon pala tanaman asli Kepulauan Banda di Maluku.
model_answer.en: The nutmeg tree is native to the Banda Islands.

meaning.en: A clove's journey.

text.en: Picked from the tree in Maluku
Sold at a market far away
Carried by ship to a big port

model_answer.id: Dipetik, dijemur, dibawa kapal, lalu dijual di negeri jauh.
model_answer.en: Picked, dried, shipped, then sold in a faraway land.

meaning.en: What did sailing ships wait for?

text.en: The seasonal wind to change direction

model_answer.id: Angin musim berganti arah kira-kira setiap setengah tahun, jadi pelaut menunggu angin yang tepat.
model_answer.en: The monsoon winds change direction about every half year, so sailors waited for the right wind.

meaning.en: Majapahit was centred on this island.

model_answer.id: Majapahit berpusat di Trowulan, Jawa Timur.
model_answer.en: Majapahit was centred at Trowulan, East Java.

meaning.id: Keluar dari atau masuk ke Nusantara?
meaning.en: Going out of, or coming into, the islands?

model_answer.id: Rempah dan cendana dijual ke luar. Kain dari India dan keramik dari Tiongkok dibeli pedagang Nusantara.
model_answer.en: Spices and sandalwood went out. Cloth from India and porcelain from China came in.

meaning.en: The Maluku Islands were nicknamed the ____ Islands.

model_answer.id: Maluku dijuluki Kepulauan Rempah.
model_answer.en: Maluku was nicknamed the Spice Islands.

meaning.en: The tool for finding direction at sea?

model_answer.id: Kompas menunjuk arah utara, jadi pelaut tahu arah di laut lepas.
model_answer.en: A compass points north, so sailors know their direction on the open sea.

model_answer.id: Cari rempah di dapurmu: cengkih, pala, lada, atau kayu manis. Cium aromanya, lalu cari tahu dari daerah mana rempah itu berasal.
model_answer.en: Look for spices in your kitchen: cloves, nutmeg, pepper or cinnamon. Smell them, then find out which region each one comes from.

meaning.id: Pala dari Kepulauan Banda. Ketuk wilayahnya.
meaning.en: Nutmeg is from the Banda Islands. Tap the region.

model_answer.id: Kepulauan Banda ada di Maluku.
model_answer.en: The Banda Islands are in Maluku.

meaning.en: Coastal kingdoms grew rich because…

text.en: The sea there was always frozen
Their ports were full of traders

model_answer.id: Pelabuhan yang ramai pedagang membuat kerajaan pesisir makmur.
model_answer.en: Ports full of traders made the coastal kingdoms prosperous.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Treaty of Breda" (1667) and "Banda Islands" (britannica.com); Giles Milton, Nathaniel's Nutmeg (1999).

model_answer.id: Pala pernah sangat berharga. Dalam Perjanjian Breda tahun 1667, Belanda tetap memegang Pulau Run di Banda, pulau kecil penghasil pala, sedangkan Inggris tetap memegang Manhattan, yang kini menjadi bagian kota New York.
model_answer.en: Nutmeg was once hugely valuable. In the Treaty of Breda of 1667, the Dutch kept Run, a tiny nutmeg island in Banda, while the English kept Manhattan, which is now part of New York City.

meaning.en: Goods or services?

model_answer.id: Roti, sepatu, dan nasi adalah barang. Memperbaiki motor, mengajar, dan mengantar penumpang adalah jasa.
model_answer.en: Bread, shoes and rice are goods. Fixing motorbikes, teaching and driving passengers are services.

meaning.id: Dari sawah sampai ke meja makan.
meaning.en: From the rice field to the table.

text.en: A family cooks and eats it
A trader sells the rice at the market
The farmer grows and harvests rice

model_answer.id: Petani memanen, padi digiling, beras dijual di pasar, lalu dimasak di rumah.
model_answer.en: The farmer harvests, the rice is milled, sold at the market, then cooked at home.

meaning.en: Who produces the fish?

model_answer.id: Nelayan menangkap ikan, lalu menjualnya. Ia produsen ikan.
model_answer.en: A fisher catches fish and sells them: a producer of fish.

meaning.en: Problem → who provides the service?

text.en: You want to fly to Makassar

model_answer.id: Montir memperbaiki motor, pemadam kebakaran memadamkan api, dokter mengobati, pilot menerbangkan pesawat.
model_answer.en: A mechanic fixes motorbikes, firefighters put out fires, a doctor treats the sick, a pilot flies planes.

meaning.id: Saat makan nasi, kamu menjadi konsumen.
meaning.en: When you eat rice, you are a consumer.

model_answer.id: Konsumen adalah orang yang memakai barang atau jasa.
model_answer.en: A consumer is someone who uses goods or services.

meaning.en: Someone who makes goods is a ____.

model_answer.id: Produsen membuat barang atau memberi jasa.
model_answer.en: Producers make goods or provide services.

meaning.id: Hujan terus, panen cabai sedikit. Harga cabai…?
meaning.en: Endless rain, a small chilli harvest. Chilli prices…?

model_answer.id: Barangnya sedikit, pembelinya tetap banyak: harga cenderung naik.
model_answer.en: Less to sell, just as many buyers: prices tend to rise.

meaning.en: Buying vegetables at the market.

model_answer.id: Pilih sayur, bayar dengan uang kertas, terima kembalian, lalu pulang membawa belanjaan.
model_answer.en: Choose the vegetables, pay with a note, take the change, then go home with the shopping.

meaning.id: Modal Rp35.000. Terjual 20 gelas es teh, Rp3.000 per gelas. Untungnya?
meaning.en: Costs Rp35,000. Sold 20 glasses of iced tea at Rp3,000 each. Profit?
Prices tend to rise or fall?

text.id: Banyak orang membeli ayam menjelang hari raya
text.en: Lots of people buy chicken before a holiday

text.id: Banyak sekali penjual sayur di pasar
text.en: Lots of vegetable sellers at the market

model_answer.id: Panen melimpah dan banyak penjual membuat harga turun. Banyak pembeli atau barang langka membuat harga naik.
model_answer.en: Big harvests and many sellers push prices down. Many buyers or scarce goods push prices up.

meaning.en: Where to save the money from selling?

model_answer.id: Bank menyimpan uang dengan aman, misalnya untuk tabungan hasil berjualan.
model_answer.en: A bank keeps money safe, for example savings from selling.

model_answer.id: Main warung-warungan! Buat label harga, siapkan uang mainan, lalu bergantian menjadi penjual dan pembeli. Catat untung atau ruginya.
model_answer.en: Play shop! Make price labels, get toy money ready, then take turns being seller and buyer. Write down any profit or loss.

meaning.en: Which one provides a service?

model_answer.id: Montir memberi jasa: ia memperbaiki kendaraan orang lain.
model_answer.en: A mechanic provides a service: fixing vehicles.

meaning.en: A huge orange harvest. Orange prices…?

model_answer.id: Jeruk melimpah, penjual berebut pembeli: harga cenderung turun.
model_answer.en: Plenty of oranges, sellers competing for buyers: prices tend to fall.

meaning.id: Aku buah dari Banda. Bijiku jadi rempah yang harum. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: I am a fruit from Banda. My seed is a fragrant spice. Who am I?

model_answer.id: Pala! Bijinya jadi rempah, dan daging buahnya bisa dibuat manisan.
model_answer.en: Nutmeg! Its seed is the spice, and the fruit's flesh can be candied.
